title: Measure the work, not the people
sub: Film 2 of Ownership and performance, in Leading data people: measures are for learning how the work flows, read together by the team, to find what in the system to fix. Pair each measure with one that balances it, and never rank people by them.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: orange is data (the team's measures), amber a wait or a cost (waiting for access, too much work at once), green something done or better, and blue a plan or a rule the team keeps.
